old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display over a body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing a stark contrast to the colorful explosions of fireworks. The fireworks burst in various colors, predominantly red and white, creating a dynamic and festive atmosphere. These bursts are reflected beautifully on the calm surface of the water below, enhancing the visual spectacle. In the background, there are faint lights from buildings and structures, suggesting an urban or suburban setting. The display evolves over time, with bursts changing in intensity, color, and pattern. A small, dark, possibly silhouetted shape is visible in the water near the center of the frame in several images. The camera maintains a steady position, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.

The fireworks burst in various colors, predominantly red, blue, and white, creating a dynamic and festive atmosphere. These bursts are reflected beautifully on the calm surface of the water below, enhancing the visual spectacle. In the background, there are faint lights from buildings and structures, suggesting an urban or suburban setting. The scene remains static throughout the video, focusing on the continuous and mesmerizing display of fireworks. There are no visible characters or animals in the frame, and the camera maintains a steady position, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable movement or change in perspective.
caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display across a calm, dark body of water. Near the horizon, a smaller ground burst sits left and a larger red dome-shaped burst sits right, while a broad cluster of high blue-white sparkles hangs above. The high sparkles are brightest early in the visible display and gradually thin into faint scattered dots. The right ground burst changes in place: its red outline remains while a bright white core ignites, white streaks spread outward, and a purple-blue center emerges. The left ground burst also stays fixed but gains a brighter white core and mixed purple-blue tints. Vertical reflections mirror these color shifts, turning from red-white streaks into red, white, and purple-blue columns. A fixed city-light strip with a thin vertical beam lines the left horizon, and a dark silhouette occupies the right edge.
